listings.title: Tennis camp at Park Hotel Zanzanù
listings.scheduleNotes: Runs daily from late March to late October. The 2026 season ended on 20 October; 2027 dates are not published yet.

zanzanu-tennis-camp-lake-garda.title: Tennis camp at Park Hotel Zanzanù
zanzanu-tennis-camp-lake-garda.description: Group tennis camp on seven clay courts high above the north-west shore of Lake Garda, with lake-view rooms, half board and a spa at the four-star Park Hotel Zanzanù. Choose a 4-, 5- or 8-day package; coaching is in groups of three or four.
zanzanu-tennis-camp-lake-garda.scheduleNotes: Runs daily from late March to late October. The 2026 season ended on 20 October; 2027 dates are not published yet.
zanzanu-tennis-camp-lake-garda.priceNotes: 4 days from €401, 5 days from €515, 8 days from €797, per person in a double room with half board.

nike-adult-tennis-camp-stanford.title: Nike Adult Tennis Camp at Stanford
nike-adult-tennis-camp-stanford.description: A three-day adult camp at Stanford's Arrillaga Tennis Center, run by Stanford assistant coach and former ATP player Brandon Coupe. Players are grouped by level, from beginners to advanced.
nike-adult-tennis-camp-stanford.priceNotes: $644 for the 3-day camp; a deposit holds your place. Adults 18+.

mouratoglou-weekend-camp-templeton.title: Mouratoglou High-Performance Weekend
mouratoglou-weekend-camp-templeton.description: Friday-to-Sunday camp built on the Mouratoglou Methodology: technique, tactics, fitness and structured match play, three hours each morning. Open to all levels.
mouratoglou-weekend-camp-templeton.priceNotes: $540 per 3-day weekend (9 hours of instruction). Custom group camps on request.

st-georges-hill-grass-court-clinic.title: Grass-court doubles clinic at St George's Hill
st-georges-hill-grass-court-clinic.description: A one-day doubles clinic on four side-by-side natural grass courts at St George's Hill Lawn Tennis Club, following Jamie Murray's doubles programme. Five hours on court, six players per coach.
st-georges-hill-grass-court-clinic.venueName: St George's Hill Lawn Tennis Club
st-georges-hill-grass-court-clinic.priceNotes: £199 per day or £398 for both days. Open to players rating 2–6 on Active Away's self-rating guide.

david-lloyd-finchley-tennis-clinic.title: Doubles clinic at David Lloyd Finchley
david-lloyd-finchley-tennis-clinic.description: Five hours of doubles coaching in North London using the Jamie Murray programme. Book one day or both days of the weekend.
david-lloyd-finchley-tennis-clinic.priceNotes: £119 per day or £238 for the weekend.

brighton-tennis-padel-weekend.title: Tennis and padel weekend in Brighton
brighton-tennis-padel-weekend.description: A three-day seaside weekend at Hove Beach Park mixing 4.5 hours of tennis with 5.5 hours of padel coaching and match play, with group dinners booked in the evenings.
brighton-tennis-padel-weekend.priceNotes: £349 per person. Accommodation and meals are not included.

ikos-kissamos-tennis-holiday.title: Tennis week at Ikos Kissamos
ikos-kissamos-tennis-holiday.description: Seven nights at the five-star, all-inclusive Ikos Kissamos in western Crete with 22.5 hours of coaching. Six à la carte restaurants are included; non-players get £200 off.
ikos-kissamos-tennis-holiday.priceNotes: Per person based on two sharing; single occupancy from £5,029.

sani-beach-tennis-holiday.title: Tennis week at Sani Beach
sani-beach-tennis-holiday.description: A week on Halkidiki at Sani Resort, home of the Rafa Nadal Tennis Centre and its eight red clay courts. 22.5 hours of coaching, full board and dine-around access to the resort's restaurants.
sani-beach-tennis-holiday.priceNotes: Per person based on two sharing. Non-players get £200 off.

lensbury-tennis-weekend.title: Tennis weekend at The Lensbury
lensbury-tennis-weekend.description: Two nights at the four-star Lensbury on the Thames in Teddington, with 11 hours of coaching built on Jamie Murray's programme and organised group meals.
lensbury-tennis-weekend.priceNotes: £549 per person in a classic double or twin room, bed and breakfast.

engage-pickleball-oxford-advanced.title: Engage advanced camp in Oxford, Florida
engage-pickleball-oxford-advanced.description: A two-day, 14-hour camp for 3.75–4.5 players focused on positioning, shot selection and point construction, with no more than eight players per coach.
engage-pickleball-oxford-advanced.priceNotes: $650 per player. Skill bands are Engage's own 3.75–4.5 scale.

mark-price-acworth-camp.title: Mark Price signature camp in Acworth
mark-price-acworth-camp.description: Three-day coaching camp with PPA pro Mark Price and his staff: dinking, third and fifth shots, movement and defence, in two groups (3.0–3.5 and 3.5+) of up to 16 players.

nike-adult-pickleball-ttc-palms.title: Nike Adult Pickleball Camp at TTC Palms
nike-adult-pickleball-ttc-palms.description: A desert weekend camp with Bollettieri Pickleball in Palm Desert: over 10 hours of drills, strategy and match play, grouped from beginner to advanced. Day camp only.
nike-adult-pickleball-ttc-palms.priceNotes: $744 per 3-day camp; lunch and housing not included.

tyson-mcguffin-doubles-lab-palm-desert.title: Doubles Lab in Palm Desert
tyson-mcguffin-doubles-lab-palm-desert.description: A one-day lab for established doubles teams led by Matthew Marceau: communication, positioning, movement patterns and team tactics in live play. Both partners register.
tyson-mcguffin-doubles-lab-palm-desert.priceNotes: $599 per player; you must attend with your doubles partner.

tyson-mcguffin-los-barriles-festival.title: Los Barriles pickleball festival
tyson-mcguffin-los-barriles-festival.description: Three mornings of clinics with Tyson McGuffin on the Sea of Cortez, with tournament warm-ups and level-matched recreational play.
tyson-mcguffin-los-barriles-festival.priceNotes: $1,499 per player, 8am–2pm each day. Travel and accommodation not included.

pickleball-in-paradise-la-toc.title: Pickleball clinic week at Sandals La Toc
pickleball-in-paradise-la-toc.description: Daily clinics with IPTPA master coaches John and Leesa Walker at Sandals Regency La Toc, an all-inclusive resort beneath the Pitons, plus mixers, round robins and a beach farewell dinner.
pickleball-in-paradise-la-toc.priceNotes: From $3,699 per person, double occupancy. $400 deposit.

pickleball-getaways-club-med-turkoise.title: Pickleball week at Club Med Turkoise
pickleball-getaways-club-med-turkoise.description: Six nights on Grace Bay at the adults-only Club Med Turkoise with daily clinics from touring pros (six players per coach or better), level-matched play, trivia night and a catamaran trip.
pickleball-getaways-club-med-turkoise.priceNotes: $3,380 per person sharing; $3,990 single. Balance due 30 December 2026.

empowher-punta-cana-retreat.title: Empowher women's retreat in Punta Cana
empowher-punta-cana-retreat.description: A women-only week with 9+ hours of daily clinics from top pros, themed nights and an all-inclusive resort stay. For players rated 3.0 to 4.5.
empowher-punta-cana-retreat.priceNotes: $2,900 per person sharing; $3,200 single. Sold out, waitlist open.

active-away-pickleball-vilamoura.title: Pickleball break in Vilamoura
active-away-pickleball-vilamoura.description: Three nights at the Hyatt Regency Vilamoura near the beach and marina, with 11 hours of structured pickleball, four players per court and planned group dinners.
active-away-pickleball-vilamoura.priceNotes: Per person sharing, bed and breakfast.

rafa-nadal-academy-padel-camp.title: Padel & Fitness Camp at Rafa Nadal Academy
rafa-nadal-academy-padel-camp.description: A Sunday-to-Sunday week in Manacor with 12 hours of padel in groups of four and 5 hours of padel-specific fitness, staying at the academy's residence. Groups are set by level on day one.
rafa-nadal-academy-padel-camp.scheduleNotes: Bookable year-round, Sunday to Sunday, subject to availability. A 4-night half-week is also offered.
rafa-nadal-academy-padel-camp.priceNotes: From €960 per week including 7 nights at the Rafa Nadal Residence (price as listed by The Padel Circle; the academy quotes on request).

m3-padel-week-madrid.title: M3 Padel Week in Madrid
m3-padel-week-madrid.description: A Monday-to-Friday intensive in Madrid with high-level coaches, classes adapted to every level and optional hotel packages.
m3-padel-week-madrid.priceNotes: €1,450 training only; €2,000 with 5 nights at Exe Getafe; €2,900 with 5 nights at Hard Rock Hotel Madrid.

emilio-sanchez-padel-week-barcelona.title: Padel week at Emilio Sánchez Academy
emilio-sanchez-padel-week-barcelona.description: Weekly and weekend padel programmes in Barcelona with English-speaking coaches. The Gold week adds an hour of fitness to two hours on court each day.
emilio-sanchez-padel-week-barcelona.scheduleNotes: Weekly programmes run Monday to Friday and weekend programmes Friday to Sunday, year-round.
emilio-sanchez-padel-week-barcelona.priceNotes: Weekly: Gold €930, Silver €660. Weekend: Gold €603, Silver €396. Taxes included.

premier-padel-finals-experience-barcelon.title: Premier Padel Finals clinic in Barcelona
premier-padel-finals-experience-barcelon.description: Four days of FIP-method coaching (12+ hours, four players per court) with video analysis, an internal tournament, and a Category A ticket to the Premier Padel Finals at Palau Sant Jordi.

advantage-padel-nottingham-clinic.title: Padel clinic at Advantage Padel Nottingham
advantage-padel-nottingham-clinic.description: A one-day clinic on four reserved indoor courts, with separate beginner and intermediate programmes and four players per coach.
advantage-padel-nottingham-clinic.priceNotes: £229 per person. 6 March and 4 December are beginner days; 7 March is intermediate.

great-western-glasgow-padel-clinic.title: Padel clinic at Great Western, Glasgow
great-western-glasgow-padel-clinic.description: Four hours of coaching on the Louie Harris programme, four players per court, with a beginner day and an intermediate day.
great-western-glasgow-padel-clinic.priceNotes: £159 per person. 10 July is for beginners, 11 July for intermediates.

active-away-padel-barcelona.title: Padel long weekend in Barcelona
active-away-padel-barcelona.description: Three nights at the four-star AC Hotel Victoria Suites with 12.5 hours of coached padel over four days, four players per coach in the mornings.
active-away-padel-barcelona.venueName: AC Hotel Victoria Suites by Marriott
active-away-padel-barcelona.priceNotes: From £999 per person sharing, bed and breakfast; the April date is £1,079.

active-away-padel-vilamoura.title: Padel break in Vilamoura
active-away-padel-vilamoura.description: Three nights at the Hyatt Regency Vilamoura with coached padel sessions and group dinners, a short walk from the marina.
active-away-padel-vilamoura.priceNotes: From £849 per person sharing, bed and breakfast.

active-away-padel-nana-golden-beach.title: Padel week at Nana Golden Beach
active-away-padel-nana-golden-beach.description: A week at the five-star, all-inclusive Nana Golden Beach on Crete with 22 hours of padel coaching, match play and tournaments, and a court for every four players.
